integration: Outbound price-check links. No live player-market feed or copied market-price database.

sources.name: MapleStory Market
sources.method: Player-shop observations, listed prices and history; do not equate listings to completed sales.
sources.note: Account page explicitly offers API keys. Privacy policy confirms administrator approval of requests. No key has been obtained and no public endpoint contract was verified. Do not scrape around the provider’s browser checks.

sources.name: NiaMeowDB
sources.method: Item search and inventory screenshots; player-reported prices and shop observations.
sources.note: Bulk database reuse and automated collection require permission. Links only.

sources.name: MesoWatch
sources.method: Reads player-shop video/recordings. Distinguishes asking prices and observed sales; incomplete or delayed observations are possible.
sources.note: Automated price-table collection and redistribution require written permission. Links only.

sources.name: Free Market Classic
sources.method: FM Sync shop observations over 14 days; listed, typical and sold values are separate.
sources.note: No documented reusable public feed verified in this investigation. Not integrated.

npcValues.meaning: Sell Price from the pinned game export, per item. Not an NPC purchase cost or player-market quote. Unknown is never zero.
npcValues.example: Work Gloves: NPC sell-back 1200 mesos. Red Potion exported sell value is 5, not its shop purchase cost of 50.

gameData.note: Public browser-accessible Classic World API, MCW/1. Not a live market-price feed. Full listing captured with count=20000 yielded 7432 records. Item details are cached on selection. White Jeans 1067027 has cash=true; no NPC sell price is supplied. The legacy GitHub bulk route is not deployed and is not used.
